name: Article 19 – 209-213
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing an EU talent pool
section: Article 19 – title | Article 19 – paragraph 1 | Article 19 – paragraph 2 – introductory part | Article 19 – paragraph 2 – point a | Article 19 – paragraph 2 – point b
part_text: Immigration procedures / 1. Each participating Member State may put in place the immigration procedures provided by their respective national laws to allow for the recruitment of registered jobseekers from third countries who have been selected for a job vacancy in the EU Talent Pool. / 2. The procedures referred to paragraph 1 shall include: / (a) the obtention of visas and national residence permits for work purposes; / (b) the necessary security checks according to national law and with relevant EU databases including the Schengen Information System.
